## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A single governor query returns the current headroom estimate and observed...

The system SHALL ensure that a single governor query returns the current headroom estimate and observed consumption for each of the six capacity sources.

#### Scenario: A single governor query returns the current headroom estimate and observed...

WHEN `build-the-account-wide-usage-governor` is implemented
THEN A single governor query returns the current headroom estimate and observed consumption for each of the six capacity sources.

### Requirement: A dispatch whose preferred source lacks headroom is queued or raises a...

The system SHALL ensure that a dispatch whose preferred source lacks headroom is queued or raises a decision card, and a test proves no dispatch executes on a lower tier or different vendor without a recorded decision.

#### Scenario: A dispatch whose preferred source lacks headroom is queued or raises a...

WHEN `build-the-account-wide-usage-governor` is implemented
THEN A dispatch whose preferred source lacks headroom is queued or raises a decision card, and a test proves no dispatch executes on a lower tier or different vendor without a recorded decision.

### Requirement: OpenRouter spend stops at the operator-set budget; a dispatch that would...

The system SHALL ensure that openRouter spend stops at the operator-set budget; a dispatch that would exceed it is refused with a card and not executed.

#### Scenario: OpenRouter spend stops at the operator-set budget; a dispatch that would...

WHEN `build-the-account-wide-usage-governor` is implemented
THEN OpenRouter spend stops at the operator-set budget; a dispatch that would exceed it is refused with a card and not executed.

### Requirement: Changing an archetype's primary implementer from Claude to Codex in the...

The system SHALL ensure that changing an archetype's primary implementer from Claude to Codex in the routing configuration changes routing with no code change.

#### Scenario: Changing an archetype's primary implementer from Claude to Codex in the...

WHEN `build-the-account-wide-usage-governor` is implemented
THEN Changing an archetype's primary implementer from Claude to Codex in the routing configuration changes routing with no code change.

### Requirement: The governor reports usage under a single Claude account and has no...

The system SHALL ensure that the governor reports usage under a single Claude account and has no configuration path for pooling multiple seats of one vendor.

#### Scenario: The governor reports usage under a single Claude account and has no...

WHEN `build-the-account-wide-usage-governor` is implemented
THEN The governor reports usage under a single Claude account and has no configuration path for pooling multiple seats of one vendor.

### Requirement: When always-on-agent-automation ri-10 signals are absent the governor...

The system SHALL ensure that when always-on-agent-automation ri-10 signals are absent the governor reports its own estimate and names the missing signal source; when present they are used without a governor code change.

#### Scenario: When always-on-agent-automation ri-10 signals are absent the governor...

WHEN `build-the-account-wide-usage-governor` is implemented
THEN When always-on-agent-automation ri-10 signals are absent the governor reports its own estimate and names the missing signal source; when present they are used without a governor code change.
